svg.title: Plate 01 — Axis-EVO Flagship Agent Workbench
svg.desc: Local-first trustworthy AI Agent workbench with immutable skill versioning, SHA-256 verification, Docker sandbox, and Obsidian Prism workbench preview.

g.text: 本地优先的可核验 AI Agent 工作台与受控 Skill 演化系统
